rationale: The proposal preserves all 85 authored boards from my exact signed candidate review: 45 Intrusul and 40 Perechi, with no exclusions. The current native audit binds this catalog and candidate and covers all 85 boards through ordinary seeded HTTP selection: create, unchanged initial resume, every winning action, 1000-point terminal state and terminal reload, totaling 460 requests. Its checks preserve private identities and hidden predicates at creation, keep unsolved Perechi predicates hidden after each match and preserve the terminal win and score. I verified all 155 recorded runtime digests, including all three native auditors, all nine current source bindings, the current editorial source hash and the catalog/rubric/KG/pack/core bindings. The exact native audit evidence and independent semantic/ranking diagnostics contain no quality blocker. The later installed check and exact-SHA qualification remain required.
